newsitem.title: ITALY: Visit the kids or go to jail, Italian told.
newsitem.headline: Visit the kids or go to jail, Italian told.

text.p: An Italian court ordered an absent father on Thursday to visit his two young daughters at least four times a year or face jail and a fine.

The case of the 32-year-old man, who was not named, was brought before judge Roberto Settembre by his former wife for failure to pay monthly support payments to the family that were agreed in court in 1993 after a consensual separation.
Settembre sentenced the man to six months in jail and a fine of 500,000 lire ($330) but suspended the punishment on condition that he paid more attention to the girls, aged four and seven.
"The total lack of time he has spent with the daughters, especially the younger one, has damaged the psychological balance of the little girl," Settembre wrote in the ruling.
"It would therefore be useful at least in part to restoring this balance for the father to visit them at least once every three months and spend six hours with them."
